entry_points.text: Creation via system call or device operation validates flags against a shared set plus user-only bit, checks privilege or sysctl allowance for unprivileged kernel-fault handling, allocates a context, pins caller space and publishes a nonblocking anonymous file; init registers the misc device, context slab cache and sysctl controls.

Control multiplex requires prior negotiation except for negotiation itself and routes register, unregister, wake, copy, zero, move, protect, continue, poison, read-write-protect and mode commands; file ops bind release, poll, iterated read, control, compat control, seek and conditional info reporting queue counts and negotiated identity.

Poll attaches to the descriptor queue, demands initialization and nonblocking mode, and reports readability when unread fault or event queues hold entries; read requires initialization and room for one message, blocks only for the first message then drains without waiting.

Register copies the request except trailing output, rejects empty or unknown modes, translates supported modes to space flags and rejects exclusive write-tracking combos; unregister validates the range, requires live space and single owner, wakes missing-mode waiters per subspan and clears area by area.

Wake and write-protect validate ranges and require live space where applicable, delegating to filtered wake and to a range protection walk; copy and zero abort quickly while mappings change, publish transferred length, optionally wake by span and signal retry unless fully done.

Overcommit tuning exposes policy, ratio, absolute kilobytes and user and admin reserves through a virtual-memory control table registered early; policy writes are range checked, ratio and absolute forms clear each other, and entering strict mode refreshes batching and syncs counters before publishing.

exports.text: Bounded duplication for kernel strings and raw buffers guarantees termination, shares a bounded copy core, reuses read-only resident strings, scales counts safely, and returns null on failure; user variants allocate from a dedicated bucket pool and report allocation or copy faults via error pointers.

Small helpers identify the current stack by testing the stack pointer against an area and replace area file backing with reference upkeep; locked-memory charging succeeds immediately for empty or missing descriptors and otherwise checks privilege before delegating.

User mapping rejects offset plus aligned length wrap and subpage offsets; shadow stack creates a read-write anonymous private region for current, fixed non-replacing when an address is given and opting out of huge pages when that build option exists.

Kernel virtual allocator offers byte, node, range, array and zeroing forms; array forms fail cleanly on count times size overflow, zeroing forms request cleared pages, and unsupported modifier bits are masked to a supported set with a one-time diagnostic.

Layout area exposes stack, page, break and mmap randomization, legacy detection, top-down base computation and layout selection; commit area exposes a limit query combining swap with absolute or percent reserve and a non-negative usage query over a shared counter.

hazards.text: Zero-length wake matches all waiters so callers assert nonzero length; poll readability does not guarantee nonblocking read; refile must keep waiter linkage nonempty across queue moves; zero progress is a broadcast wake with warning and short completion means retry, while races with space changes fail rather than block.

Reject offset plus length wrap, subpage offsets, count times size overflow, empty or larger-than-RAM sizes, and occupied entries, missing pages or invalid frames without leaking half-built areas; duplication must handle null input, allocation and copy failure, termination overflow and page-range overflow; no-fail reservation and costly high-order pages retry with sleep and divert failures to async cleanup.

Userfault ABI facts: readability EPOLLIN and error EPOLLERR with O_NONBLOCK and IOCB_NOWAIT; errors EINVAL, EFAULT, EAGAIN, ERESTARTSYS, ESRCH, EPERM, EBUSY, ENOMEM; modes MISSING, WP, RWP, MINOR with copy, zero and protect modifiers; event FORK; register-mode, range-ioctl and basic sets; shared fcntl flags; feature RWP; toggleable set limited to async read-write-protect; distinct ids for version, features and each control op; VM flags UFFD MISSING, WP, RWP, MINOR, MAYWRITE, NONE and mask with PAGE_MASK and task sleep, wake and running states.

Memory tuning facts: minimum gap 128MB, maximum gap five-sixths of stack top, stack randomization mask 8MB as page-shifted value; defaults guess policy, fifty percent ratio, zero absolute kilobytes meaning ratio mode, standard map count, 128MB user and 8MB admin reserves; bulk zero-order fulfilment capped at 100 pages; range allocation spans virtual-alloc start to end with base alignment trying larger granularities first.

Relies on external helpers for copying and string work, build predicates, randomness, privilege and compat checks, error pointers, warnings and fatal checks, barriers, one-shot stores, rodata tests, atomics, cleanup guards, file publication, bulk and diagnostic allocation, signal tests, cache flush, page translation and validity, and sanitizer hooks.

invariants.text: Pending selection returns nothing when idle and otherwise returns the oldest waiter by reverse traversal, giving readers first-in first-out order.

Ranges require page alignment where demanded, nonzero page-multiple length, start below task limit, whole span inside limit and no wrap; mapping also rejects offset plus length wrap and subpage offsets without attempting work.

Fork handling drops the event lock to create a new descriptor, then requeues and completes on success or preserves for retry on failure with different reference handling; resolution publishes a read-only shared-flag descriptor number in the fork payload after clearing stash.
Wake first samples both fault queues under sequence retry with scheduling opportunity after ordering, and only if waiters are indicated does it lock and wake filtered by address span.

Registration requires a live space, locates covering areas, enforces huge-page alignment at span ends, writability and accessibility for tracking, single-owner rule, and forbids silent removal of write-tracking flags; success reports usable ops narrowed for huge pages and masked by requested modes.

Copy, zero, move, continue, poison, wake and protect refuse work while mappings change, validate spans, require the bound space to stay alive, reject unknown mode bits, publish progress, and map lifetime loss to a missing-process error; copy allows only no-wake and write-protect, zero only no-wake, move only hole-tolerance and no-wake with same-address and dual-range checks.

Negotiation checks protocol version, requires privilege for fork tracking, expands async write-protect to include unpopulated tracking, requires base read-write-protect for its async variant, reports full available sets, refuses outside bits, publishes the result, and allows one success with failure clearing output; availability shrinks when arch minor, page-table, marker or read-write-protect support is absent.

Randomization applies only under opt-in or arch defaults with direction-aware stack offset, aligned clamped page offset, smaller break window for compat tasks and width-selected mmap offset; locked accounting needs write exclusion, enforces lock limits unless bypassed, warns on release underflow and emits a debug record.

Shadow regions are always anonymous private read-write with fixed placement exactly when an address is given and huge-page use disabled when supported; range allocation rejects empty or larger-than-RAM sizes and masks modifiers; backing arrays larger than one page use zeroed reclaimable virtual allocation and smaller ones use node-local slab, permitting high memory unless device memory was asked.

Range installation requires empty targets, present pages and valid frames with distinct busy, memory and argument failures, granularity at least base page size, and conditional table sync; fulfilment tries large blocks without reclaim then bulk zero-order chunks with policy awareness, stops on fatal signals unless no-fail, and accounts pages; modifiers suppress warnings, shed no-fail for large or non-blocking contexts, and run table work under a restricted scope.

Ratio and absolute kilobyte controls clear each other so at most one shapes the limit; policy changes recompute batching, sync the committed counter on every processor when entering strict mode, then publish; limit uses absolute pages when configured else RAM minus huge-table pages scaled by percent, always plus swap, and usage never reports negative.

locks.text: Reader orders descriptor queue lock before pending queue lock, moves entries between queues under pending lock with sequence protection, uses a separate event lock for events, and counts or wakes both pending and general queues under pending lock with interrupts disabled.

Registration, unregistration, feature mutation, locked accounting and shadow-stack creation hold address-space write exclusion across search and update while pinning the space and allowing rescheduling; feature mutation drains per-region readers then publishes the feature word with one atomic store.

Leaf table installation enables lazy update mode across a batch and disables it after, marking the table modified; descriptor publication orders field stores before clearing the uninitialized marker with a write barrier paired with read barriers on inspection.

state_machines.text: Central reader prefers pending faults over events, sleeps interruptibly when both are empty unless no-wait was asked, aborts on signals, completes ordinary events at once and diverts fork events to temporary holding with an extra reference.

Mode setting accepts disjoint enable and disable sets limited to toggleable supported bits, requires base before async, drains in-flight faults under write exclusion, publishes once, and wakes all waiters when entering async; continue, poison and move write back byte progress where full completion succeeds, short completion asks retry, no-wake suppresses wake else the affected or destination span is woken.

Mmap base chooses legacy bottom-up for compat personality, unlimited stack on downward-growth systems or sysctl default, else top-down with a gap from stack limit plus guard and randomization pad clamped between bounds minus randomization; a fallback config always uses bottom-up at a fixed base.

Range allocation runs reservation, backing acquisition, table install, sanitizer handling, publication and leak tracking, trying huge granularity first then base, retrying no-fail reservations with sleep, and diverting failures to async cleanup; kernel install descends table levels allocating missing intermediates, advances a shared leaf index stride by stride with continuity for large pages, then does cache maintenance.

structs.text: Context carries reference count, creation flags, feature word starting clear, released marker, changing lock and counter, bound space pointer, wait queues for descriptor readers, unread faults, read faults and events, and a refile sequence tied to the pending lock; slab init prepares queues and sequence while creation finishes counts, locks and pin.

Area registration couples flag bits with an owning context pointer kept consistent, and fault messages carry an event discriminator with fork stashing producer context then descriptor number; file behavior uses a main ops table and a device ops table plus a misc descriptor with dynamic minor.

Virtual area descriptors carry base address, backing page pointer array, present count, mapping granularity order, flags including allocation, uninitialized and huge bits, caller address and deferred-cleanup list node; order storage is arch-gated and must be zero where huge virtual mappings are unsupported.
